findings.detail: Ruby Bidco term loan cost_currency is GBP from the par/principal field, but the source amortized cost and fair value are dollar-denominated.
Jupiter Refuel Canada term loan cost_currency is CAD from the par/principal field, but the source amortized cost and fair value are dollar-denominated.
Jupiter Refuel Canada revolving credit facility cost_currency is CAD from the local principal context, but the source cost and fair value cells belong to the dollar-denominated valuation columns.

rationale: FX03 is a row-level cost_currency flag. The raw SOI rows show local currency only on the par/principal side for the foreign-denominated instruments, while amortized cost and fair value are in dollar valuation columns. The stored U_GBP/U_CAD cost_currency therefore reflects the instrument/principal currency rather than the USD-denominated BDC valuation currency.
